spans.s: --the place where कृष्ण, Arjuna and भीम met युधिष्ठिर after the fall of जरासन्ध. भा. X. ७३. ३२.
--forest burnt by Arjuna, and Maya was liberated from the fire. Here Arjuna defeated Indra. भा. I. १५. 8; X. ५८. २५-7; ७१. ४५-46; ८९. ३४ [4].
(I)--the son of Mitadhvaja. He knew the truth of Karma. He was afraid of केशिध्वज. भा. IX. १३. २०-21.

(II)--(Janaka, Vasudeva) the latter of which name is explained by केशिध्वज in early times;
1: Vi.

. ८१-7.
heard on yoga; son of Amitadhvaja and king; in hostility driven out by केशिध्वज came to him to consult on the form of expiation; after being instructed and after the penance, केशिध्वज called over again to pay the precep- tor's fee; खाण्डिक्य who had no more concerns in this life asked for instruction on the doctrine of the soul; heard of the nature of योग from केशिध्वज; making his son master of his belongings went to the woods for penance.
2: Ib.
